planSummary: Aligned Story 4 package publication around same-project membership plus bounded current package-building context, then refreshed coverage so mixed-producer package publish/review/export and reopened pinned-version reuse are exercised end to end.

changedFiles.reason: Updated the in-memory package publication path to validate same-project members against current refs or already-pinned package-context versions instead of same-process production.
Reworked durable package snapshot publication to allow mixed-producer members only when they belong to the same project and are valid in the publishing process’s current package-building context.
Expanded package snapshot tests for mixed-producer success, cross-project rejection, and bounded-context rejection.
Added package-context durability coverage for ordered upsert/read behavior, duplicate cleanup, clear behavior, and republishing an earlier pinned version after reopen.
Adjusted package review fixtures and assertions so mixed-producer package members remain reviewable with pinned provenance.
Adjusted export fixtures so mixed-producer packages still export pinned contents successfully.
Seeded current refs in package-publication integration paths so the stricter Story 4 publication eligibility rule is exercised correctly.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run convex/packageSnapshots.test.ts convex/processPackageContexts.test.ts tests/service/server/package-review-api.test.ts tests/service/server/review-export-api.test.ts tests/integration/review-workspace.test.ts --environment node

findingsFixed: Removed the outdated same-process package publication restriction from both durable and in-memory publication paths.
Added regression coverage for mixed-producer package publication, review, export, and reopened pinned-version reuse.
Fixed the integration fixture omissions exposed by the stricter publish rule by seeding the publishing process’s current refs where publication is expected to succeed.

recommendedNextStep: Hand off to verification; both the Story gate and Epic gate are green.
